source: OpenAI native image_gen through Codex using the OpenAI provider
purpose: Illustrative CFD previews for the dicehub Community project gallery. These are synthetic artwork, not solver results.
rights: Generated for the dicehub documentation preview. Documentation artwork is excluded from the repository MIT license.
processing: Center-cropped and reduced from the original generated images to 800 by 500 pixels with Lanczos resampling; WebP quality 78, compression method 6, no metadata. No upscaling.

Asset type: landscape CFD project thumbnail for a clean technical software gallery, used on a Community project card.
Scene/backdrop: pale cool gray background.
Style/medium: crisp engineering visualization; professional CFD post-processing viewport with realistic proportions, restrained gray geometry and detailed mesh or streamlines. Selective blue/cyan/green/yellow velocity or pressure contours with occasional small red high-value regions only where appropriate.
Composition/framing: landscape composition, identifiable central geometry. Keep the complete subject inside the central 85 percent so a 16:10 card crop retains it. Prefer the highest native landscape output. Create one single image.
Constraints: illustrative synthetic CFD artwork, not a claim of measured or validated simulation results.
Avoid: software chrome, labels, letters, scales, axis legends, title, watermark, logos, collage, dark backgrounds, border, or human figures.
